## Checklist

- [ ] Docstrings added or updated (Google-style) for new modules, classes, and functions
- [ ] Code passes `make lint` (ruff + black --check) and `make typecheck` (mypy)
- [ ] `make test` passes locally
- [ ] Documentation updated where relevant
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private data are included in the diff
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and contain no AI co-author trailers
